payload.title: A judge group's second or re-minted seat is minted at the later call's HEAD while the first seat keeps its own tree, and since the arbiter hold such a mixed-seat group has no producer rule and no exit: neither arm mints, nothing re-asks a seat at a common tree, and both paid judge calls end in a group that never settles.
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:90-100 (the group id is run-free, so a missing seat is minted by a later night's call)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:508-520 (a seat already minted is skipped by (group, agent); a seat skipped for backlog on one role is left for a later call)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:552-567 (the later mint stamps that call's target_sha)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/anchor_stale_effects.py:115-124 (the anchor-stale lane re-mints a dead judge at gate.head())
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_remint.py:100-107 (the other re-mint entry resolves the workspace HEAD)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:1004-1009 (the split arm holds the mixed group and mints nothing)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/genesis_policy.py:125-128 (measured: 296 of 462 minted judge envelopes died of anchor staleness, each one a candidate for a re-mint at a later HEAD)
payload.rule_violated: A closing set is judged at one tree (ARIA-HIGH-004 and J5: feedback_store.tree_is_mixed, generate_ai_consensus target_sha_mixed); a producer that creates mixed-tree groups and a consumer that refuses them, with no rule between, is a pipeline stage with no output.
payload.notes: Night 1 mints seat A at tree T1 (the other role is skipped by the backlog cap or its envelope dies of staleness); a later night re-mints or self-heals seat B at HEAD T2. The group now holds {A at T1, B at T2}: _group_tree reports the hold, both arbiter arms skip it, the governance row counts it, and no lane re-asks A at T2 or B at T1, so the two paid judge calls never become consensus or an anchor. With main moving nightly and most envelopes dying of staleness, this is the common path for any re-minted seat, not a corner. Close condition: Decide and implement the producer rule (a missing or re-minted seat is minted at the tree its surviving seat judged, or the group is re-minted whole at one tree) in the seat producers, pinned by a test that runs dispatch_judges_for_sample (or the anchor-stale re-mint) over two cycles at two target_shas and asserts _group_tree returns a tree, not ARBITER_HOLD_SEATS_MIXED_TREE. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
